HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

2. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.

   D. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
